body:
## Code Review

This pull request removes the unpaged query option to ensure that all question searches, including those in product mode, remain range-bounded. It also updates the ranking logic to apply to the bounded page window returned by the repository. The reviewer feedback focuses on defensive programming, suggesting that several functions (rankProductQuestionSearchRows, searchQuestions, and normalizeQuestionSearchVisibility) should explicitly normalize null inputs to empty arrays or objects to prevent potential TypeError crashes, and that corresponding regression tests should be added.
